jobs_results.title: Analista /Gestor de Aplicaciones (ERP, SAP)
jobs_results.description:
Desde About Your Talent, nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Applications Analyst para una importante empresa internacional.

Las principales funciones del puesto incluyen:
• Documentación de los procesos, procedimientos, y guías relacionados con su ámbito de responsabilidad.
• Gestionar las distintas aplicaciones, principalmente SAP B1 y SAP R/3, con el fin de asegurar la correcta implantación, administración, operación, mantenimiento y soporte de las mismas de forma eficiente y proveyendo un servicio adecuado.
• Gestionar y coordinar con proveedores externos el desarrollo de los proyectos y servicios vinculados con aplicaciones de la empresa.
• Integración de los servicios de la empresa y las aplicaciones tanto internas como externas.
• Gestionar el ciclo de vida de las aplicaciones, asegurando la calidad y el mínimo impacto de las nuevas implantaciones mediante el control de las versiones y sus despliegues.
• Analizar y detectar las necesidades de las distintas áreas... trasladándolas a los requerimientos técnicos adecuados para su desarrollo en SAP B1 y SAP R/3.
• Gestión y coordinación de proyectos dentro de su ámbito de responsabilidad.
• Proporcionar soporte en la resolución de incidencias.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia demostrada de al menos 3 años en posiciones similares.ç
• Ingeniería o Grado Superior FP II en Informática.
• Nivel de inglés: B2.
• Experiencia en análisis, diseño funcional y diseño técnico de soluciones basadas en SAP B1 y SAP R/3.
• Experiencia en integraciones de aplicaciones via Webservice.
• Experiencia con entornos de SQL Server / Hanna.
• Certificaciones ITIL.
• Capacidad para coordinar y gestionar a proveedores externos ( servicios, integraciones, desarrollo).
• Excepcionales aptitudes para la resolución de problemas y capacidad para trabajo bajo presión.
• Excelentes dotes de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.
• Capacidad de gestión y organización para cumplir los plazos establecidos.
• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y proactiva.

Contrato Indefinido

jobs_results.title: Técnico ERP SAP PLM
jobs_results.description:
Desde LHH Recruitment Solutions seleccionamos para empresa multinacional líder en el sector automoción ubicado en Ultzama un /una Técnico SAP PLM.

La principal función será: Transición de datos desde el sistema actual de gestión empresarial (BAAN) hacia el nuevo sistema ERP, TEAM CENTER/ PLM - SAP.

Para ello realizará:
• Planificación de la Migración: Desarrollar y ejecutar un plan detallado para la migración de datos, considerando los requisitos del negocio, las restricciones de tiempo y los recursos disponibles.
• Análisis de Datos: Evaluar la calidad y la integridad de los datos existentes en el sistema BAAN, identificando posibles problemas.
• Mapeo de Datos: Diseñar y crear mapas de datos precisos que definan cómo se transferirán los datos desde el sistema BAAN al sistema PLM TEAM CENTER, asegurando una correspondencia adecuada entre los campos y las estructuras de datos.
• Extracción y Transformación de Datos.
• Validación y Pruebas.
• Documentación.

Requisitos

Experiencia... profesional en empresa industrial de al menos 2 años en el desempeño de sus funciones o similares con SAP PLM

jobs_results.description:
Para incorporación a nuestra oficina de Murcia seleccionamos consultor en implantación de sistemas ERP.

Buscamos personas con un espíritu emprendedor y entusiastas de su trabajo, creativas, comprometidas con los demás, en permanente búsqueda de la excelencia y con capacidad para el trabajo en equipo.

FUNCIONES:
• Estudio de una compañía, análisis de cómo funciona, cómo se organiza, cómo están relacionados los distintos procesos de negocio dentro de la empresa, análisis de necesidades y diseño de soluciones eficientes que mejor se adaptan a las características de la compañía.
• Planificación de actividades del proyecto y coordinar al personal implicado. Seguimiento del proyecto, cumplimiento de la planificación, revisión del sistema y estándares de calidad.
• Realizar informes de consultoría, memoria de proyecto, etc.
• Parametrización y realización de pruebas.
• Formación a usuarios.
• Ayuda a usuarios en la puesta en marcha de proyectos, resolución de dudas e incidencias.
•... Asesoramiento a los clientes en todas las áreas relacionadas con las tecnologías de la información y procesos de negocio.

Condiciones
• Tipo de industria de la oferta: Servicios y tecnología de la información
• Categoría: Informática y telecomunicaciones - ERP, CRM, Business Intelligence
• Nivel: Especialista
• Personal a cargo: 1 - 5
• Horario: Lun-Jue 8:30-14:00 / 16:00-19:00 Vie 8:30-14:00
• Salario: 18.000€ - 24.000€ Bruto/año
• Beneficios sociales: Porcentaje sobre objetivos; Kilometraje; Teléfono móvil; Flexibilidad horaria y organizativa; Plan de conciliación laboral y familiar; Otros beneficios: Ambiente empresarial joven y dinámico.

• Estudios mínimos: Formación Profesional Grado Superior - Informática
• Experiencia mínima: Al menos 1 año

Conocimientos necesarios
• ERP
• Consultoría
• Tecnologías de la información
• Mejora de Procesos
• Análisis
• Procesos de negocio
• Alimentación
• Calidad
• Trabajo en equipo
• Contabilidad

Requisitos mínimos
• Profesional con estudios técnicos o universitarios.
• Experiencia en la implantación de ERPs u otros sistemas de mejora de procesos.
• Se valorará experiencia en sector alimentación y afines.
• Capacidad de trabajo en grupo y para liderar el desarrollo de un proyecto.
• Habilidades para la comunicación verbal.
• Habilidades para impartir formación.
• Imprescindible conocer los procesos de negocio típicos de una compañía (compras, ventas, almacén, producción, contabilidad).

jobs_results.title: Business Analyst ERP AMM
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for an IS/IT Business Analyst AMM ERP (Planned Maintenance Module in SAP and complimentary applications in PM and SHE area) to join a global Barcelona IT team with a multi-disciplinary and multi-category business context

Position Snapshot

Location: Esplugues de Llobregat (Barcelona) – Relocation required

Type of Contract: Permanent, full time

Type of work: Hybrid/Remote

Work Language: Fluent Business English

The role

In this position, you will establish and maintain a connection between IS/IT & business Consumers and Customers. As part of the Product Group Team, you will ensure a deep understanding of opportunities and issues facing business functions and advises on the best IT solutions. Furthermore, you will translate business strategies, opportunities, threats and needs into IS/IT product requirements and will play a key role within the Product Group Team to specify, test and deploy those IS/IT solutions.

What You’ll Do
• Project Management: Gather functional... requirements, write functional specifications, and coordinate with onshore/offshore developers and vendors for projects related to SAP-based solutions (PM Module) and other applications in Planned Maintenance and SHE area.
• System Improvement: Identify, build, test, and implement changes to current systems to ensure compliance, improve performance, and usability. Drive root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for continuous improvement.
• Support and Training: Act as the third level of support for AMM-PM and complimentary applications, analyzing and resolving incidents. Support onboarding and training of new team members. Oversee the delivery of training to end-users and support teams.
• Strategy and Documentation: Support the development of the strategy through incremental improvement of the product. Ensure training materials for the Product Group area are documented. Consult with product managers to define the minimum viable product (MVP) and propose alternative solutions.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Coach, motivate, and direct staff from various organizations (business and IS/IT) to understand business needs and find solutions that align with customer objectives and IS/IT strategy. Partner with business stakeholders, BRM, and Product Group Manager to elicit, analyze, translate, and document business requirements into IS/IT requirements.

We offer you

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

Great benefits including competitive salary and a comprehensive social benefits package. We have one of the most competitive pension plans on the market, as well as flexible remuneration with tax advantages: health insurance, restaurant card, mobility plan, etc.

Personal and professional growth through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.

Hybrid working environment with flexible working scheme. Our state-of-the-art campus is dog friendly and equipped with a medical center, canteen and areas to co-create network and chill!

Recreation activities such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities.

Minimum qualifications:
• Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, sciences, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent. Minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience in a relevant functional area.
• Business Understanding: Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate them into application requirements. Excellent understanding of business complexity and interdependencies. Extensive business experience in a relevant function is beneficial.
• Project Implementation: Extensive project implementation experience, with a track record of successfully delivering results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Understanding of various software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).
• Communication and Language Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with additional languages as a plus. Extensive experience with effective communication at different levels in an organization.
• Technical Skills: Understanding of basic system engineering, information risk and security guidelines, and architecture standards. Expertise in configuration, implementation of best practices, and knowledge of the latest functionalities available. Understanding of modeling techniques.
• Additionally, above-average organization and prioritization skills are required, with the ability to juggle multiple responsibilities and stakeholders simultaneously. The ability to work and collaborate in a virtual team with people across countries and different cultures and time zones is essential.

Bonus Points If You:

Knowledge of Nestlé IT support model (tickets, offshores, RM, IM, Change, etc.) is a plus

Knowledge of Nestlé IT SAP governance and maintenance model is a plus

About The IT Hub

At Nestlé IT, we are a diverse, global team of IT professionals in the biggest health, nutrition and wellness company of the world. We strive to create an environment where people are valued for who they are. We innovate every day through future ready technologies to create opportunities for Nestlé to delight consumers, customers and employees alike. We collaborate with partners around the world to deliver tangible value at global scale. We continuously work to develop our people to be future ready.

About Nestlé

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company in the world, with a presence in more than 185 countries. With net sales of CHF 94.4 billion in 2022, the company has over 291,000 employees and 418 factories in 85 countries. Our values are based on respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity, and respect for our future. Nestlé is dedicated to offering high-quality food and beverage products and services that contribute to the nutrition, health, and well-being of people, pets, and the planet. Additionally, it is committed to being a leading company in sustainability and achieving net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Want to learn more? Visit us at: www.nestle.com

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

Join Nestlé #beaforceforgood

How we will proceed:

You send us your CV → We contact relevant applicants → Interviews → Feedback → Job Offer communication to the Finalist → First working day

• Strategy and Documentation: Support the development of the strategy through incremental improvement of the product. Ensure training materials for the Product Group area are documented. Consult with product managers to define the minimum viable product (MVP) and propose alternative solutions.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Coach, motivate, and direct staff from various organizations (business and IS/IT) to understand business needs and find solutions that align with customer objectives and IS/IT strategy. Partner with business stakeholders, BRM, and Product Group Manager to elicit, analyze, translate, and document business requirements into IS/IT requirements.

We offer you

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

Great benefits including competitive salary and a comprehensive social benefits package. We have one of the most competitive pension plans on the market, as well as flexible remuneration with tax advantages: health insurance, restaurant card, mobility plan, etc.

Personal and professional growth through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.

Hybrid working environment with flexible working scheme. Our state-of-the-art campus is dog friendly and equipped with a medical center, canteen and areas to co-create network and chill!

Recreation activities such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities.

Minimum qualifications:
• Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, sciences, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent. Minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience in a relevant functional area.
• Business Understanding: Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate them into application requirements. Excellent understanding of business complexity and interdependencies. Extensive business experience in a relevant function is beneficial.
• Project Implementation: Extensive project implementation experience, with a track record of successfully delivering results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Understanding of various software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).
• Communication and Language Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with additional languages as a plus. Extensive experience with effective communication at different levels in an organization.
• Technical Skills: Understanding of basic system engineering, information risk and security guidelines, and architecture standards. Expertise in configuration, implementation of best practices, and knowledge of the latest functionalities available. Understanding of modeling techniques.
• Additionally, above-average organization and prioritization skills are required, with the ability to juggle multiple responsibilities and stakeholders simultaneously. The ability to work and collaborate in a virtual team with people across countries and different cultures and time zones is essential.

Bonus Points If You:

Knowledge of Nestlé IT support model (tickets, offshores, RM, IM, Change, etc.) is a plus

Knowledge of Nestlé IT SAP governance and maintenance model is a plus

About The IT Hub

At Nestlé IT, we are a diverse, global team of IT professionals in the biggest health, nutrition and wellness company of the world. We strive to create an environment where people are valued for who they are. We innovate every day through future ready technologies to create opportunities for Nestlé to delight consumers, customers and employees alike. We collaborate with partners around the world to deliver tangible value at global scale. We continuously work to develop our people to be future ready.

About Nestlé

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company in the world, with a presence in more than 185 countries. With net sales of CHF 94.4 billion in 2022, the company has over 291,000 employees and 418 factories in 85 countries. Our values are based on respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity, and respect for our future. Nestlé is dedicated to offering high-quality food and beverage products and services that contribute to the nutrition, health, and well-being of people, pets, and the planet. Additionally, it is committed to being a leading company in sustainability and achieving net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Want to learn more? Visit us at: www.nestle.com

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

Join Nestlé #beaforceforgood

How we will proceed:

You send us your CV → We contact relevant applicants → Interviews → Feedback → Job Offer communication to the Finalist → First working day

jobs_results.title: Enterprise Resources Planning Manager
jobs_results.description:
Are you passionate about managing complex IT projects and ensuring seamless execution? Do you have experience and a track record leading ERP transformation programs? This role is pivotal in Berry Global’s ERP transformation, one of Europe's largest JDE ERP implementations. Join us in shaping the future of IT at Berry Global and leave a lasting impact on our organization.

This position will bring deep expertise, knowledge & structure to the program, and ensure implementation projects remain on schedule and within the allocated budget. Working with management executives, this position will regularly inspect and report on the project’s progress.

Sant Cugat del Vallès in Barcelona is our headquarters and Berry's Centre of Excellence and Innovation Hub. Which is specified as the role location. We welcome applicants from within Europe and the role has the flexibility to be based in any European country.

The role is hybrid, with a mixture of work locations, which also includes working... from home. The post requires 50-70% travel to other Berry sites, which will include overseas travel within Europe and globally.

Berry Global is is a Fortune 500 global manufacturer and marketer of plastic packaging products and specialty materials publicly traded on the NYSE. We pursue excellence in all that we do and are always advancing to improve the way we work along with the products and services we provide. With our proven expertise in packaging and protection solutions, and a dedicated insights team that follows trends across a range of industries, we are uniquely positioned to serve a broad range of markets and customer needs.

ERP Program Manager

Responsibilities
• Lead and manage multiple implementation projects in a multi-vendor environment, ensuring they align with organizational objectives and are delivered within predefined timelines.
• Own the change control, governance, and release management processes for the ERP global template, including scheduling, coordinating, improving, and managing releases across various environments, but also maintaining comprehensive release management policies and procedures to streamline the software deployment lifecycle.
• Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing regular updates on project statuses, and producing process documentation and project reports for various stakeholders.
• Lead and coordinate design/implementation efforts and resource needs with internal teams and external partners.
• Manages highly complex business issues arising from the implementation of new processes or functions
• Creates positive impact, can influence using effective relationship skills and foster team collaboration. Strong communication, presentation, and leadership skills
• Maintains and controls the ERP project budget, schedule, and resources. Manages project scope, risk, and issue resolution
• Responsible for ERP implementation, including project planning, resource allocation, steering committee leadership and team organizational structure management.
• Responsible for quality of project deliverables
• Responsible for ensuring that the project can deliver the benefits outlined in the business case, and that it meets the reasonable expectations of end users
• Develop, build, and implement project management tools, templates, processes, and controls to ensure best practices are applied to all implementations, ensuring consistent execution and synergies
• Lead, manage and ensure continuous development of the program team, providing guidance, establishing a structured framework, and resolving program-related challenges for smooth project execution.
• May be responsible for procurement of package-related hardware, software, and services

Primary Contacts
• Line of business (LOB) managers for business users affected by the project
• All IT associates involved in the selection, design, implementation, rollout and/or update of the ERP/business application
• Business stakeholders/ERP steering committee
• Heads of governance bodies needed to make the necessary decisions
• Support leader
• Hardware, software, and service vendors

Education

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information systems, technology, business administration or related field; or equivalent work experience.

Project Management Certification (PMP/PgMP from PMI, PRINCE2 or APM) is a plus.

Experience
• 10 to 15 years of IT and business/industry work.
• Track record of leading successful ERP implementations (e.g., an ERP project that realized its anticipated business benefits and was delivered in a timely manner within budgetary boundaries).
• Oracle/JDE ERP experience is highly desirable.
• Three to five years of leadership responsibility managing midsize to large teams and influencing senior-level management and key stakeholders.

Knowledge/Skills
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to speak to technical-level staff and summarize communications for executive consumption.
• Excellent project management skills, with a demonstrated record of accomplishment.
• Excellent management and team-building skills.
• Utilizes project management software tools and processes to effectively manage, monitor and control project activities.
• Ability to analyze, understand and effectively communicate between business requirements and technical design and implementation.
• Budget planning and management.
• Working knowledge of applications being implemented and integrated with the core ERP software.
• Problem-solving, negotiation and decision-making skills to influence management as well as internal and external partners.
• Demonstrated leadership abilities; effective in matrix management and team building.
• Works well with others in an integrated team environment.
• Self-motivated and a problem solver.
• Experienced in facilitation and negotiating.
• Intercultural competence.
• Must have excellent level of spoken/written English. Other language skills are not essential but advantageous.

Working Conditions

Flexibility to travel internationally as needed to support ERP implementation projects across various locations. Travel Required: 50%-70

jobs_results.description:
Las funciones del puesto de trabajo son:

1.- Implantación de nuestras soluciones APPOLO y APPOLO TRAFFIK

2.- Formación y fidelización de los clientes ya existentes

3- Coordinación de los proyectos de implantación

4.- Elaborar la documentación necesaria para concursos públicos a los que nos presentamos con estos productos

Responsabilidades

1. Soporte a clientes de primer nivel y coordinación general del soporte con el departamentos técnicos

2. Trabajo proactivo para incrementar el nivel de uso y satisfacción entre los clientes con las herramientas de APPOLO y APPOLO TRAFFIK

3. Apoyo en las labores de preventa

4. Apoyo en la elaboración de propuestas, proyectos y concursos desde el punto de vista de consultoría y todo lo referente a cumplimiento ENS

5. Coordinación e Implantación de soluciones Appolo y Appolo Traffik en los clientes nuevos que requieran de Proyecto de Instalación

Requisitos

1. Grado en informática, Telecomunicaciones o experiencia en desarrollo del entorno... similar al utilizado de al menos 3 años

2. Conocimientos del ENS y de la ISO 27001

3. Se valorarán conocimientos Sistemas Operativos WINDOWS y LINUX

4. Se valorarán conocimientos NETWORKING (VPN, FIREWALL, etc.)

5. Se valorarán conocimientos BBDD (SQL Server y MaríaDB)

6. Se valorarán conocimientos en Análisis y Gestión de Riesgos tecnológico

7 Se valorará experiencia en implantación de ERP o similar
